It Takes 4 Metrics to Audit Billing and Fix ROI for Your Large Practice

These metrics make up 60% of your billing process's efficiency, productivity, and financial performance. The figures are taken from the first-hand experience of our clients.

30-40 days

Days in Accounts Receivable

Accounts receivable tracks the average number of days a practice takes to collect payment due. PMEX maintains lower A/R days and ensures faster reimbursement across all payers and all sites.

98%

Net Collection Rate

The overall collection from the patient and the insurer makes up the net collection rate. PMEX ensures payment is timely received and the net collection rate stays high across all provider locations.

✓

97%

First Pass Acceptance Rate

Also known as the first-pass clean claim rate, it measures the acceptance rate of the first claim submission. PMEX delivers quality RCM for a consistently high first-pass rate, minimizing rework and delays.

1%

Denial Rate

The ratio of claims denied by the insurer shows how effective your RCM is. PMEX follows up on denied claims, identifies the root cause, rectifies errors, and maximizes revenue generation on every resubmission.

Medical Billing Services to Streamline Revenue Cycle Management for Large Practices

Simplify the complexities of medical billing and enhance financial and healthcare productivity with this billing flowchart.

Insurance Verification and Eligibility

Ensure prior authorization and verify insurance eligibility for all medical services across every provider and site before each encounter.

Patient Registration

Collect, verify, and enter patient data to ensure accuracy and error-free billing documentation across all providers and locations.

Claims Submission

With a 99% clean claim rate, PMEX submits accurate claims to ensure a high first-time pass rate and maximum collection rate across all payers.

Coding and Documentation

AAPC-certified coders prevent errors and inaccuracies in diagnostic and procedural coding. ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS accuracy verified on every claim.

Denial Management

Root-cause analysis of every denial. Claims corrected and resubmitted within 48 hours. 97% denial reduction for large practices. 98% appeal overturn rate.

Payment Posting

Payments received from insurers and patients are posted daily for record keeping. Co-pay and balance due notifications sent to patients with full transparency.

A/R Follow-Up

Systematic follow-up on all pending payments and accounts receivables. Every balance across 30, 60, and 90+ day buckets worked daily until resolved.

Patient Billing

Patients are billed accurately for the services they have received. Statements generated and delivered for all patient-responsible balances.

Education and Outreach

By proactively engaging with providers, PMEX helps staff understand patients' financial obligations and encourages timely payments before balances age.

Our Efficient Work Process to Achieve These Goals Faster

24/7 Access to Reporting and Infrastructure

The PMEX Portal gives your large practice real-time visibility into billing performance across every provider and site, updated by your billing team around the clock. When you partner with PMEX, you gain access to live reporting infrastructure without spending on software or hardware. Collections, denials, A/R aging, and payer scorecards are always one login away.

Regular Auditing and Quality Control

PMEX ensures regular internal audits to scan for inaccuracies and identify areas for improvement in your billing processes. We rectify error patterns and enforce quality control measures, including double-checking claims and conducting regular reviews. This allows a reduction in revenue holes and billing inaccuracies across your entire group.

Upfront Communication

Clear and effective communication between insurers, administrative staff, and billing personnel is essential for long-term work partnerships. PMEX establishes communication pathways from day one, improving trust among all parties involved and preventing misunderstandings and errors that cost large practices revenue.

Expertise and Specialization

Experience and professionalism are key metrics for fewer denials. PMEX has a team of trained experts skilled in coding, billing, and claims submission across 67 specialties. Your large practice taps into this knowledge base to access compliant billing practices from day one, without training costs or ramp-up time.

Simplifying Complex Coding (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS)

PMEX stays updated with the latest regulatory changes, coding guidelines, and insurance requirements. Our coders are fully versed in ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems to ensure accuracy and faster collection. Every payer rule change is tracked and applied across all claims without any action required from your team.
